name: Normative claim

subjectOf.text: Regulatory cycles would benefit from supplementing, rather than replacing, the existing regulatory framework with dynamic elements.
subjectOf.abstract: The author identifies common elements of regulatory crises and suggests normatively that regulatory cycles could benefit from supplementing the existing regulatory framework with dynamic elements.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857
scope_conditions: dynamic elements operate as a supplement to stable rules

subjectOf.text: A shift toward WDAG based dynamic solutions is not merely attractive but necessary for a legal system that is both efficient and equitable in addressing the complexities of contemporary governance.
subjectOf.abstract: As such, a shift toward WDAG-based dynamic solutions is desirable and necessary for creating a legal system that is both efficient and equitable in addressing the complexities of contemporary governance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4957318
scope_conditions: contemporary governance under rapid technological and societal change
